settingsAiModels.title: AI models
settingsAiModels.description: Which model each AI feature runs on. Everything inherits the workspace default unless you say otherwise.
settingsAiModels.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
settingsAiModels.aiDisabled: AI is switched off for this workspace, so nothing below is running. These choices are kept and will apply again when it is switched back on.
settingsAiModels.notConfigured: No AI provider is set up yet, so there is no model to choose.
settingsAiModels.defaultFromWorkspace: From this workspace's own provider and key.
settingsAiModels.defaultFromPlatform: From the platform's configuration — this workspace has not set its own.
settingsAiModels.inheritingCount: {count} of {total} features here follow this group.
settingsAiModels.autosave: Changes apply to the next AI call. Nothing already running is affected.
